## `UpdateIPAccessRestrictions`

**PUT** `/v2/manage/restrictions/ip-access`

Update IP Access Restrictions

Updates the IP access restrictions for a specific Tenant.

### Example

```c#
public static async Task CallUpdateIPAccessRestrictions(LoginRadiusClient client) {
    IPAccessRestrictions iPAccessRestrictions = new IPAccessRestrictions("<allowedIPs>", "<deniedIPs>"); //Required

    try {
        var response = await client.IPAccessRestrictions.UpdateIPAccessRestrictionsAsync(iPAccessRestrictions);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```
